$comment: Integration declaration for every packages/domain leaf, enforced by `bun run check:integration` (scripts/check-integration.ts). A leaf with no consumer outside packages/domain is dead code. Wiring it is the goal; where wiring is genuinely blocked, this file records who is missing and what would unblock it. Do not delete a leaf to silence this file: wire it, or state the real reason.

leaves.reason: Packet leaves capture, adapter reads and receipts with the capability owners; no adapter exists that could call it.
leaves.unblockedBy: An agent capability owner reading retained workspace state through a named application operation.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps schedule retirement and disposition persistence with the reserved asset owner; no asset register owner exists yet.
leaves.unblockedBy: The asset register owner gains retained schedules, then a disposal application operation calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps posting, matching and persistence with the bank intake owners, which are not built.
leaves.unblockedBy: Bank intake persists provider observations, then its application owner composes this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps claim/lease persistence with the connector owners; no sync window table exists.
leaves.unblockedBy: A connector owner owns the window table and calls this leaf at each page boundary.

leaves.note: NEXT-45 owner apps/api/src/application/reports/cash-flow-statement.ts composes the leaf from retained postings read through apps/api/src/db/reports/cash-flow-statement.ts inside the caller's transaction, exposed as POST /v1/entities/:entityId/books/:bookId/cash-flow. Opening and closing cash are derived from retained journal lines, never accepted from the request. Read-only, so no migration.

leaves.reason: NEXT-38 is a calculation leaf whose cash-method application owner was never built.
leaves.unblockedBy: The cash/bank owner adopts this leaf for cash-method assignment.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps sealed-message delivery and dispute handling with the commerce/delivery owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A delivery owner sends the sealed message and calls this leaf for reminder admission.

leaves.reason: Leaf exists with no packet, no progress row and no owner; provenance is unknown.
leaves.unblockedBy: Identify the packet and owner, then wire it, or delete the leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps revision append and report-time resolution with the dimension/report owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A report owner resolves classificationAt and calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the provider protocol and receipts with the signing adapter owners; no adapter is selected.
leaves.unblockedBy: A signing adapter is qualified, then its owner calls this leaf for intent freezing.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the payout-route handoff with the claim/payroll owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A payroll owner pays a reviewed claim and calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps provider state and receipts with the external-delivery owners; filing is outside current authority.
leaves.unblockedBy: Separate authority for an external filing provider, then a delivery owner calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Reviewed and repaired as a pure leaf. Packet keeps cash mutation and reconciliation with the banking owners, which are not built.
leaves.unblockedBy: A banking owner owns foreign cash holdings, then its application owner calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the owning transaction and correction while accepted scope stays open.
leaves.unblockedBy: An FX owner accepts a correction scope, then its transaction calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Leaf exists with no packet, no progress row and no owner; provenance is unknown.
leaves.unblockedBy: Identify the packet and owner, then wire it, or delete the leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps persistence with the sie/historical and commerce settlement owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A settlement owner persists an adoption and calls this leaf for residual allocation.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps valuation and persistence with the asset owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: An asset owner persists carrying amounts and calls this leaf for a reversal.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the treasury handoff with the treasury owners; no loan owner exists.
leaves.unblockedBy: A treasury owner persists a loan timeline and calls this leaf for accrual.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps payroll handoff with the claim/payroll owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A payroll owner settles a reviewed claim and calls this leaf for the distance split.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the payroll period handoff with the payroll owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A payroll owner settles a paid period and calls this leaf for recovery.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps persistence and invalidation with the directory owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A directory owner persists a reviewed resolution and calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the payment-batch/export owners; no payment batch owner exists.
leaves.unblockedBy: A payment-batch owner executes an allocation and calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the payroll run posting and payslips with the payroll owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A payroll owner owns a run and calls this leaf for its journal.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps transport and persistence with the delivery owners; no access point is qualified.
leaves.unblockedBy: An access point is qualified, then a delivery owner calls this leaf for dispatch admission.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps schedule and invoice resolution with the subledger/commerce owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A subledger owner persists a schedule and calls this leaf for allocation.

leaves.reason: Reviewed and repaired as a pure leaf. Packet keeps fetching, profiles and persistence with the treasury/banking owners, which are not built.
leaves.unblockedBy: A treasury owner owns processor observations, then its application owner calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet requires checkpoint capture, backup and restore under separate operations authority, which is not held here.
leaves.unblockedBy: Operations authority for backup/restore, then an operations owner calls this leaf.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the declaration and migration journey with the SIE owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A SIE owner declares a partition and calls this leaf for the comparison.

leaves.reason: Packet keeps the payroll handoff with the payroll owners.
leaves.unblockedBy: A payroll owner runs a pay period and calls this leaf for variable components.
